summary: With L5R_GODOT set, tools/env.sh fills the worktree's .tools/godot-nuget feed from the shared Godot install so a fresh worktree restores and builds the client without its own Godot/.tools
validation: Fresh detached worktree with L5R_GODOT: sourcing env.sh under set -e (twice, idempotent) created the 4 nupkgs and dotnet build of L5R.Client succeeded, 0 errors. Before the change the same worktree failed NU1301.
